payload.title: 10 Mykonos Wedding Venues for a Cycladic Celebration
payload.audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, often with parents contributing, planning 40 to 150 guests who will fly in via a European hub or Athens. They have chosen Mykonos (or are weighing it against Santorini and the wider Cyclades) and now need to choose an area, from the sheltered west-coast bays near Mykonos Town to the south-coast beaches and the quieter north, then shortlist venues compared on the same terms: setting, ceremony options, capacity, rooms and exclusive use.
payload.goal: Speak with a Wedded Advisor: request a Wedded Concierge consultation so an advisor can check availability, ceremony options and house rules for the couple's shortlisted Mykonos venues on their dates and guest count.
payload.angle: Every venue in this guide says on its own official site that it hosts weddings, and each is described with the same fields in the same order, so a resort with a ballroom, a boutique hotel with a whitewashed chapel and a villa let for exclusive use can be compared honestly. Mykonos lists tend to mix party beach clubs with real wedding venues and rarely say which part of the island a venue sits in; this guide groups 10 venues by area (Agios Ioannis, Ornos and Mykonos Town; Psarou and Platis Gialos; Elia and the north coast; private villas), writes house rules a venue does not publish as 'Not published' for the Wedded Advisor to confirm in writing, and adds short sourced sections on getting there, when to marry and the legal steps in brief. 'Cycladic' is used only where a venue describes itself that way.
must_include: Intro with a direct answer in the first 100 words: Mykonos's main wedding areas and that the right one depends on guest count, ceremony type and setting; link /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-venues prominently and the hub /destinations/europe/greece.
At a glance: 6-column table (venue, area, type, ceremony options, capacity, exclusive use) with 'Not published' where not published.

How to compare like for like: resort vs boutique hotel with chapel vs villa with exclusive use vs event venue; ceremony type on site (civil, Orthodox or symbolic only as stated); seated capacity; rooms; the single Wedded Advisor line and Wedded Concierge invitation sit in this section.
Choosing an area: west-coast bays near Town, south-coast beaches, the north coast, as practical guidance only from visitgreece.gr or venue sources; no unsourced distances or drive times.

10 venues grouped by area, each from official pages only, same fields in the same order: location and setting; ceremony options as stated; capacity, rooms and exclusive use where published, else 'Not published'; one standout detail. Santa Marina, Myconian Collection and Grecotel Mykonos Lolita re-checked live with fresh wording. Booking checklist for house rules not published. Swap failures from reserves; do not pad (title count changes if fewer qualify). No prices.
Getting there: Mykonos airport and port from official sources only; no transfer arrangements.
When to marry: hnms.gr averages for Mykonos; meltemi only as an official source states it; Smartraveller heat and wildfire advice.

Legal in brief: Embassy Athens and Smartraveller re-checked, dated as at November 2026 once; link the Greece venues guide's legal section; /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once. Nothing on church or religious paperwork.

FAQ (4 to 6): Which part of Mykonos suits a wedding? Can we book a venue or villa for exclusive use? Do Mykonos venues have their own chapels? How do guests get to Mykonos? When is the best time to marry in Mykonos? Can Australians legally marry in Mykonos?

Links: /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages, /wonderland-concierge (primary in comparison section and at close), /magazine as the magnet. UTMs utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=mykonos-wedding-venues&utm_content=primary|secondary|magnet|closing.
avoid: Any price, fee, minimum spend or amount; any capacity, room count, distance or time not on an official source.
Venues without a weddings offer on their own site (Cavo Tagoo unless a weddings page now exists, fact_16); beach clubs and party venues; anything off Mykonos.

Research talk in copy (what we could or could not find, trace or confirm; sources; method; 'you will often read'; myths sections); per-line source credits; hedge stacking; 'often told' more than once; customs with meanings or origins stated as fact.
Ranking as 'best'; order by area with a stated logic.
Competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking and review sites, Instagram, Pinterest or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording or images.
Vendor names other than venues; venue contact or business details; transfer arrangements; implying partnerships or preferred rates.
Wedded Privileges; Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md; more than one Advisor line; 'from first idea to the last dance', 'last dance'; legal, church or religious paperwork detail.
Clichés (fairytale, dream day, breathtaking), exclamation marks, pasted keywords or bracketed keywords in headings, em dashes, US spelling.
AI images of any venue, destination or wedding.
